# [EPIC] Maintenance, Dependency Upgrades & Housekeeping

## Epic
Routine maintenance work that keeps the project healthy but delivers no user-facing slice on its own: dependency bumps, toolchain upgrades, security hardening, and small chores.

## Business Value
Keeps dependencies patched, secret disclosures eliminated, and the toolchain current without silently drifting outside the issue tracker.

## Product Goal alignment
Indirectly serves the Product Goal (docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md) by keeping the platform's foundation maintained — not a feature Epic itself.

## Notes
Stays open — maintenance is ongoing (future dependency bumps/chores get new Tasks under #77, or a new Story here if the shape changes).
